newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MACROASIA RISES 17.24 PCT ON JV TALKS.
newsitem.headline: MACROASIA RISES 17.24 PCT ON JV TALKS.

text.p: MacroAsia Corp shares rose 75 centavos, or 17.24 percent, to 5.10 pesos in late trade on Thursday and traders said it was likely due to rumours the firm is in talks with an airline to provide catering services.
"There's talk that it is in the midst of joint venture discussions with a big airline to provide catering services. It's a worldwide trend that this type of service is farmed out," said one broker.
MacroAsia officials were not immediately available for comment.
MacroAsia is 70 percent owned by Philippine Airlines, the country's flag carrier.
Last month, MacroAsia said it is negotiating with PAL to take over ground services including catering and cargo handling.
